title: Shade a flat green ball, then outline it
fixture: local pal = Palette(8) pal:setColor(0, Color(0, 0, 0, 0)) pal:setColor(1, Color(20, 40, 30)) pal:setColor(2, Color(30, 90, 60)) pal:setColor(3, Color(60, 170, 80)) pal:setColor(4, Color(140, 220, 110)) pal:setColor(5, Color(230, 250, 180)) pal:setColor(6, Color(24, 20, 37)) pal:setColor(7, Color(255, 255, 255)) s:setPalette(pal)
for y = 0, 31 do for x = 0, 31 do if (x - 15.5) ^ 2 + (y - 15.5) ^ 2 < 100 then img:drawPixel(x, y, Color(60, 170, 80)) end end end
steps: /skill:shade-sprite Shade this flat ball with light from the top left, 3 bands, using the palette's greens.
Now add a selout outline around it, darker than the shading.

criteria.desc: the result is on AI: layers
an opaque pixel just outside the original circle (the outline)
criteria.code: local s = app.sprite local img = Image(s.width, s.height, ColorMode.RGB) img:drawSprite(s, 1) local a = app.pixelColor.rgbaA(img:getPixel(15, 5)) return { ok = a == 255, detail = a }

criteria.desc: the top-left of the ball is brighter than the bottom-right
criteria.code: local s = app.sprite local img = Image(s.width, s.height, ColorMode.RGB) img:drawSprite(s, 1) local function L(x, y) local v = img:getPixel(x, y) return app.pixelColor.rgbaR(v) * 0.3 + app.pixelColor.rgbaG(v) * 0.59 + app.pixelColor.rgbaB(v) * 0.11 end local tl, br = L(10, 10), L(21, 21) return { ok = tl > br + 20, detail = { tl = tl, br = br } }
